zh.title: Simple Flying報導Condor A320因宵禁被拒降法蘭克福
zh.summary: Condor A320錯過法蘭克福宵禁被拒降；乘客滯留機場
body: 航空新聞網站Simple Flying於2026年9月15日報導，Condor營運的一架空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）在嘗試降落法蘭克福機場時，因僅以秒之差錯過機場宵禁限制，於875呎高度被管制單位拒絕繼續進場。
報導稱，這項決定導致機上乘客在深夜被迫滯留於機場路邊，未能按計畫抵達航廈。
Simple Flying的報導標題指出該航班「錯過法蘭克福宵禁僅數秒，在875呎被拒降」，摘要則形容「倒楣的乘客被留在半夜的路邊」。

en.title: Simple Flying Reports Condor A320 Missed Frankfurt Curfew by Seconds, Denied Landing at 875 Feet
en.summary: Condor A320 misses Frankfurt curfew; denied landing at 875 feet; passengers stranded overnight
body: Aviation news site Simple Flying reported on 15 September 2026 that a Condor-operated Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) attempting to land at Frankfurt Airport was denied continued approach at 875 feet after missing the airport's curfew by mere seconds, based on its article published that day.
The article states that this decision left passengers stranded on the airport curb in the middle of the night, unable to reach the terminal as planned.
The headline noted the flight "Misses Frankfurt Curfew By Seconds, Denied Landing At 875 Feet", while the summary described "Unlucky passengers are left on the curb in the middle of the night."

zh.title: 無人機國際學院下週登記 太平洋友邦飛手最快年底來台受訓
zh.summary: 無人機國際學院下週法人登記；帛琉等三友邦飛手最快年底來台受訓。
body: 外交部於9月15日說明，由民間資金全額成立的「無人機國際學院」（Global UAV Academy，GUAVA）預計於下週進行財團法人登記。該學院實體辦公室規劃於今年底前，在台北與嘉義完成設立，旨在協助友邦建構無人機韌性。
行政院最新施政報告指出，無人機國際學院首階段聚焦「飛手人才培育」。外交部表示，相關培育方案將由太平洋友邦優先推行，台灣先前已於太平洋島國論壇峰會期間，與帛琉、馬紹爾群島及吐瓦魯簽訂合作備忘錄。
根據外交部說明，帛琉、馬紹爾群島及吐瓦魯的首批種子飛手學員，最快將於今年底或明年初開始受訓，屆時預計最多可同時有30名學員在台接受專業培訓。

en.title: Taiwan's Global UAV Academy to Train Pacific Ally Pilots by Year-End
en.summary: Taiwan sets up Global UAV Academy with Pacific allies sending drone trainees starting late this year.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on September 15 that the privately funded Global UAV Academy will complete non-governmental foundation registration next week. The institution plans to establish physical offices in Taipei and Chiayi by the end of this year to assist diplomatic allies in building unmanned aerial vehicle capabilities.

According to an Executive Yuan report, the academy's initial stage focuses on drone pilot training. The foreign ministry stated that the initiative will begin with Pacific allies, following memorandums of understanding signed with Palau, the Marshall Islands, and Tuvalu during the Pacific Islands Forum summit.

The first batch of trainees from Palau, the Marshall Islands, and Tuvalu is expected to begin training in Taiwan as early as late this year or early next year. The program plans to accommodate up to 30 trainees simultaneously in Taiwan.

zh.title: 維珍航空加速A330客機退役將由SAS接收舊機
zh.summary: 維珍航空引進新A330neo；SAS接收其舊寬體客機以擴充機隊
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，維珍航空（Virgin Atlantic）正在加速旗下空中巴士 A330-300 客機的退役計畫。與此同時，北歐航空（SAS）則將接手維珍航空這批最為老舊的寬體客機，藉此快速擴大其自身的寬體客機機隊規模。
在引進新飛機方面，維珍航空正在陸續接收並引進全新的 A330neo 客機，這也成為其加速淘汰舊款客機的推動力。而北歐航空目前正尋求快速擴展其寬體機隊，因而選擇接收維珍航空退役下來的舊型寬體客機。

en.title: Virgin Atlantic Accelerates A330-300 Retirements as SAS Takes on Oldest Widebodies
en.summary: Virgin Atlantic accelerates A330-300 retirements; SAS acquires its oldest widebodies to expand fleet.
body: According to a report published by the aviation news website Simple Flying, the airline Virgin Atlantic is actively accelerating the retirements of its Airbus A330-300 fleet.

At the same time, SAS is set to take on the oldest widebody aircraft from Virgin Atlantic's fleet. This acquisition of these oldest widebodies is happening as SAS looks to quickly expand its own widebody fleet.

Furthermore, Virgin Atlantic is currently onboarding brand new Airbus A330neo widebody aircraft. This onboarding of brand new A330neos is taking place as SAS looks to quickly expand its widebody fleet.

zh.title: Eurocontrol完成iNM系統升級推出全新航空資訊產品
zh.summary: Eurocontrol推出eEAD新數位產品以提升航空資訊一致性。
body: Eurocontrol 已成功在升級後的「歐洲航空資訊服務資料庫」（eEAD）中，完成推出三項全新數位產品。此升級透過整合網路管理（iNM）數位轉型計畫的 Wave 2.5 版本進行，旨在使航空資訊服務提供者能夠在單一且經過驗證的系統內，完成數位化資料管理與分發工作。
目前有超過 60 個國家向 eEAD 提供航空資訊，並有逾 200 個組織使用該系統。本次推出的新產品包括用於製作符合國際民航組織（ICAO）標準航圖的「航圖製作」（CHP）工具，以及用於管理與發布法定航空資訊發布物（AIP）的「AIP 製作」工具。

en.title: Eurocontrol Rolls Out New eEAD Digital Products Under iNM Wave 2.5
en.summary: Eurocontrol has launched three new eEAD digital products to enhance European aeronautical information services.
body: Eurocontrol has completed the rollout of three new digital products in the enhanced European Aeronautical Information Services Database (eEAD). Delivered through Wave 2.5 of the integrated Network Management (iNM) digital transformation programme, these tools enable aeronautical information service providers to manage and distribute data digitally from a single validated source.

Currently, more than 60 states provide aeronautical information to eEAD, and over 200 organisations use the system. The new release introduces Chart Production (CHP) for creating aviation charts aligned with ICAO standards, alongside AIP Production for managing legally binding Aeronautical Information Publications.
